# AudioPDF for macOS

Download **`Audio-PDF-macOS-ad-hoc.zip`** from the Assets section below.

Requirements: macOS 14 or newer on an Apple Silicon Mac.

## Install

1. Unzip the download.
2. Control-click **AudioPDF.app** in Finder.
3. Choose **Open**, then confirm **Open**.

The app is ad-hoc signed but not Apple-notarized, so opening it normally the
first time may show a security warning.

## Included

- Automatic offline audio generation when a PDF is imported
- PDF-scoped playback with disabled controls until audio is ready
- Kristin, LJ Speech, and Norman US-English voices
- Full-width PDF reading view

See the repository's
[user guide](../blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md) for troubleshooting.
